name: Tulle
tagline: Wedding planning and design for couples who want the day to feel like theirs.
service_area: Across the Hudson Valley, the Berkshires, and anywhere you are willing to fly us.
reply_note: We reply to every inquiry within two working days.

steps.title: A first conversation
steps.body: An hour, on the phone or over coffee in the studio. Your date, your guest count, and what you want people to remember.

steps.title: The design board
steps.body: We turn that conversation into a palette, a floor plan, and a budget that adds up, then shortlist the venues and vendors that fit.

steps.title: Every detail, confirmed
steps.body: Contracts, tastings, fittings, and the timeline for the day, reviewed with you and signed off by every vendor.

steps.title: The day itself
steps.body: Two planners on site from the first delivery to the last car. You get married. We carry the timeline.
steps.when: From 8 am to the last dance

faqs.question: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.answer: For full planning, twelve to eighteen months is ideal. We take wedding-month coordination as late as ten weeks out when a date is free.

faqs.question: Do you travel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most of our weddings are within two hours of Hudson, and we plan a few further afield each year. Travel is quoted at cost.

faqs.question: Can we bring our own vendors?
faqs.answer: Of course. We will happily work with anyone you have already booked, and suggest people we trust for everything you have not.

faqs.question: What does it cost?
faqs.answer: Each package has a starting fee, shown on the services page. Your quote depends on guest count, travel, and how much design work the day needs.

faqs.question: Is the planning fee separate from our budget?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our fee covers our time. Your wedding budget covers the venue and vendors, and we help you plan and track every line of it.

art_direction.identity: The planner's design board: a foam-board white page where each wedding is shown as a photograph beside the palette it was built from, paint-chip swatches with names. One committed heather-plum field carries the hero panel and the inquiry band; everything else is white space and hairlines.
art_direction.type: Bodoni Moda (a high-contrast didone) for every heading, couple name, and numeral, with its italic for one or two words of emphasis. Jost for body text at 1rem with a relaxed line height, and for tracked uppercase labels at 0.75rem. Times and prices use tabular numerals.
art_direction.color: Light theme. Canvas, a petal-tinted surface band, aubergine ink in two tiers (ink, muted), and hairline lines. Primary is the heather-plum field: hero panel, inquiry band, the one filled button, and process numerals. Secondary is a pale petal used only for small marks. Swatch chip colors are content, set per wedding in the collection.
art_direction.signature: Weddings, by palette — each featured wedding is a design board: a portrait photograph with a paint-chip card of its four colors, each chip named, beside the couple, venue, season, and guest count. Keep it on the homepage and update it as new weddings are photographed.
art_direction.voice: Warm, exact, and unflustered. Talks in dates, headcounts, and hours. Short sentences. No exclamation points, no superlatives, no 'dream wedding'.
